name: What the iPhone ended
description: A hand-picked view: the plug-ins and devices that faded once the phone became the main computer.
author: codegrave

checkpoints.name: The iPhone arrives
checkpoints.note: Apple shows the iPhone in January 2007 and opens the App Store in July 2008. The phone, not the PC, becomes the computer most people carry.

checkpoints.name: The plug-ins fade
checkpoints.note: Steve Jobs's “Thoughts on Flash” (April 2010) explains why the iPhone will not run Flash. Browser plug-ins lose ground to HTML5, and Flash reaches its end on 31 December 2020.
